# Mutahir Sultan

[Ph.D. Candidate in Agricultural and Resource Economics · Colorado State University]{.job-market-affiliation}

I am an applied microeconomist working in environmental and resource economics and public policy. I study how agricultural producers respond to weather risk and policy, and how their decisions affect nearby and downstream communities.

My current work examines who bears the costs of agricultural nitrate in public drinking water, how farm drainage affects downstream flood risk, and when conservation practices reduce crop losses. I am also developing research on how crop insurance and conservation programs shape producers’ incentives to manage risk.
